name: 深圳实验室
reconstruction: five phone photos (IMG_4913/4914/4916/4917/4918; 4915 repeats 4914) with hand-picked table edges, leg columns, feet and cabinet corners; camera poses, shared focal length, leg and cabinet positions fitted with the tabletop fixed to the tape (fit_photo.py), build_scene.py, check_scene.py, preview.py (PLAN.md). Room (2026-10-27): eight panorama photos IMG_4948-4955 shot from one spot; walls, columns, ceiling levels and furniture fitted with the cabinet, wall outlets and IMG_4913's camera as scale (fit_room.py, fit_room.json)
scale_basis: tape measure (registration.json, 2026-10-21): tabletop height 0.75 m, length 1.20 m, width 0.60 m, thickness 2 cm, cabinet 75 x 120 x 45 cm, back clearance 0 cm; all fixed in the fit, no ChArUco board measured (the board lying on the table has no recorded square size or position). The fitted focal length 773.6 px agrees with the EXIF 26 mm equivalent (769 px). Robot stand NOT measured: table edge 0.13 m ahead of the root and root on the table centre line as in g1d / g1d_lab, chosen so the tabletop objects sit at y in [-0.55, -0.25] (env_cfg/robot/g1d_shenzhen_lab.yml)

photo_overlay.method: phone photos, cameras fitted to the same hand-picked pixels (fit_photo.py), so in-sample; tabletop corners and edges only; not the robot-camera overlay (overlay)

lighting.note: registered: ceiling strip lights. Since 2026-10-27 modelled at the photographed positions: three LED strips in the perforated ceiling (RectLight 0.06 m wide, 100000) and five cone-shaped downlights in the back soffit (DiskLight r 0.05 m, 1.6e6, 55 deg), 6000 K, dome 150. Intensities chosen so the irradiance at the desk, back wall and near floor matches the 2026-10-21 RTX colour match (four 1.2 x 0.15 m RectLights at 54000; desk 1.01x, wall 0.74-0.91x, floor 1.24x by numeric integration); the RTX colour match against IMG_4916 has not been redone. Not compared with the head camera

photo_match.method: Isaac RTX from each fitted photo camera (scripts/scenes/render_scenes.py --photos), median CIELAB of photo vs render over the whole frame, averaged over the photos; target |dL*| <= 5, |db*| <= 3; phone auto exposure and white balance make it indicative only

notes: Table support registered as four legs; the photos show a lift desk with two T legs, modelled as photographed. Floor registered as grey striped tiles: carpet tiles in the photos, modelled with a carpet patch rectified from IMG_4913. Room from the 2026-10-27 photos: only desks, chairs, the shelf, the railing and turnstile are modelled (no boxes, bags or loose items). In those photos the desk had been pulled off the wall and moved ~0.3 m towards the cabinet; the twin keeps the registered position (fit_photo.py) and anchors the room to the cabinet and wall outlets.
